tagline: The Tour de France, carbon bikes and the long cycle tracks of the New Territories.
why: Cycling is both a huge pro sport, with the Tour de France as one of the world's biggest events, and a popular hobby for fitness, social rides and weekend adventures. In Hong Kong, people ride the long cycle tracks of the New Territories, tackle hill climbs, or go mountain biking. Knowing the pro stars, a bit of gear talk and local routes makes cycling chat easy.

essentials.title: The Grand Tours
essentials.body: Three three-week races: the Giro d'Italia (May), Tour de France (July) and Vuelta a España (August-September). The Tour is the biggest.

essentials.title: Jerseys tell the story
essentials.body: At the Tour, yellow is the overall leader, green the best sprinter, polka dot the best climber and white the best young rider.

essentials.title: It's a team sport
essentials.body: Teams of eight protect a leader. 'Domestiques' fetch water and shield their leader from wind.

essentials.title: Types of bikes
essentials.body: Road bikes (fast, drop bars), mountain bikes (off-road), gravel bikes (mixed), e-bikes and city bikes.

essentials.title: Drafting
essentials.body: Riding behind someone saves a lot of energy, which shapes all race tactics.

essentials.title: Gear talk
essentials.body: Cyclists love talking about bike weight, carbon frames, groupsets (Shimano, SRAM), power meters and wheels.

names.name: Tadej Pogačar
names.what: Slovenian superstar; multiple Tour de France winner including 2024 and 2025, and world champion.

names.name: Jonas Vingegaard
names.what: Danish rider, Tour winner 2022 and 2023, Pogačar's great rival.

names.name: Remco Evenepoel
names.what: Belgian Olympic champion and time trial specialist.

names.name: Lance Armstrong
names.what: Stripped of seven Tour titles for doping.

names.name: Sarah Lee Wai-sze
names.what: Hong Kong track cycling legend, Olympic bronze medallist in 2012 and 2020.

names.name: Shimano
names.what: Japanese company that makes most bike components.

names.name: Giant
names.what: Taiwanese company, the world's largest bike maker.

names.name: UAE Team Emirates
names.what: Pogačar's team, the strongest in the world.

names.name: Strava
names.what: Where cyclists log rides and chase segment records.

local.headline: New Territories cycle tracks
local.detail: A 60 km network from Tuen Mun to Ma On Shan, with Tolo Harbour and Tai Po routes the most popular.

local.headline: Road cycling
local.detail: Early morning rides up Tai Mo Shan and around Sai Kung's Plover Cove.
